configuration.hooks: .agents/hooks.json in the workspace customization root (also the global customization root, and plugins/<name>/hooks.json). Top-level keys are hook names, each with optional enabled and per-event arrays.
configuration.trust: none: project hooks ran in a fresh, never-opened directory with no trust prompt, interactive or headless
configuration.headless: agy -p '<prompt>' --output-format json [--print-timeout <d>]. Tools needing the command permission are auto-denied in headless mode unless permissions.allow (user settings.json) allows them or --dangerously-skip-permissions is passed; a PreToolUse allow does not grant that permission.
configuration.mcp: documented: mcp_config.json in a customization root (.agents/) or plugins/<name>/mcp_config.json; pmcp already projects .agents/plugins/pmcp-mcp. Not exercised in this run.

session_start.notes: no such event; PreInvocation with invocationNum 0 is the first hook of a run

prompt.notes: fires before every model call, not once per prompt; no prompt text in the payload

after_tool.notes: fires only for calls that ran; not for a hook-denied call; no tool output in the payload

deny.shape: {decision: deny, reason}; the step fails with 'tool call denied by pre-tool hook: <reason>' and the model reads the reason. Holds under --dangerously-skip-permissions.

missing_decision.notes: A PreToolUse result without decision (for example {}) denies the call with an empty reason and stops that hook's handler chain. Run 1 lost every tool call this way: a recorder returning {} ran before the probe.

allow.notes: decision allow lets the hook chain pass but does not grant the headless command permission (run 2: auto-denied, run ended with no output)

context.shape: PreInvocation/PostInvocation return injectSteps [{ephemeralMessage}] (also userMessage, toolCall); transcript step EPHEMERAL_MESSAGE, source SYSTEM_SDK

stop_context.notes: Stop {decision: continue, reason} re-enters the loop and injects the reason as a SYSTEM_MESSAGE; executionNum counts re-entries (0, then 1). An unconditional continue would loop; policies must continue only when executionNum is 0. In the smoke run a continue left print mode waiting until --print-timeout.

ask.notes: decision ask / force_ask prompt the user; headless cannot prompt

fields_absent: hook_event_name (the event is known only from the configured key)

context.notes: pause, broadcast and shared_checkout notices reached the model; held context arrived at the next delivering event

turns.finding: agy 1.4.2 resets invocationNum for a later prompt in one conversation: 2 PreInvocation calls were dispatched at invocationNum 0, one per turn, so prompt policies run on every turn.
